entries.title: Open-Driver Bass-Reflex Speaker Cabinet
entries.description: One original complete static open-driver loudspeaker cabinet: continuous thick open-front case, three fixed pierced baffles, a real thick cone and rounded surround with domed dust cap, separate domed high driver and an open rectangular reflex duct into the common enclosed cavity. All parts count as one model. Not a portable radio reskin or an axial fan without blades. entries.description: One newly authored complete static twin-ball governor display for the original steam-workshop mechanical appearance direction. Intentional fixed overlapping joins are not functional bearing tolerances. One model, zero scenes, three constant opaque PBR materials, metres and ground-centred origin.

entries.title: Fictional Quadruped Skeleton Display Mount
entries.description: One complete newly authored fictional four-limbed skeletal exhibit on its dedicated low base and two fixed posts. A continuous swelled spine connects an ascending neck, thick long-muzzle skull with a true orbital opening, paired fixed jaw branches and a tapered caudal chain. Five complete rib pairs form an open three-dimensional thorax, with a separate full sternum, shoulder plates and one real open pelvic girdle. Four complete segmented limbs include swollen-ended upper/lower bones and elongated foot bones. This is a whole terrestrial quadruped display architecture, not the earlier fish skeleton stretched or supplied with additional fins, and not a live deer mesh made thin. All numeric geometry is new; no old specimen, plinth, room, label or mesh instance. Separate closed editable solid parts with intentional fixed embedded joins, three constant opaque PBR materials, metres, native Z up and bounds-centred ground origin. One illustrative display model, zero scenes. Fictional anatomy only: no real species, accurate bone count, scientific, medical, paleontological, educational, restoration, motion, load or exhibit-safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Open-Ring Armillary Display
entries.description: One original complete fixed open-ring armillary-style display: a broad circular pedestal and four curved splayed standards support an open horizontal horizon band, a larger upright meridian hoop, two tilted interior annular bands carried by paired radial trunnions, and a small central sphere on a fixed polar spindle. The large empty spaces between bands are the main body, not a solid globe recolored or the old equatorial telescope mount. All bands have finite closed thickness and the whole geometry is newly authored. Junctions are fixed intentional assembly overlaps, not free-running bearings. A fictional static astronomical display only: no accurate celestial coordinate system, calibrated scale, astronomical measurement, navigation, historical reconstruction, motion range, manufacture or structural safety claim.

entries.title: Whole Curled Palmate Fallen Leaf
entries.description: One complete newly authored curled palmate leaf-litter prop, not a leaf extracted from an existing tree, holly wreath or waterlily pad. One connected closed thin finite lamina has an asymmetric five-main-lobe silhouette with secondary tooth points and deep intervening sinuses; its narrow full petiole continues from the same material boundary. A refined continuous bent upper/lower surface lifts the outer lobes and stalk while retaining a real finite central underside ground patch. Warm dry solid PBR, no alpha cards, decals or texture veins. No botanical species accuracy, microscopic veins, growth, seasons, wind animation or ecological simulation claim. One complete leaf prop, zero scene or extra lobe/stem model count. Metres, Z up, whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin.

entries.title: Stepped Crusher and Filter Inspection Bay
entries.description: One static mine-processing inspection bay composed from two complete qualified original equipment models. A whole open-feed twin-roll crusher stands on the low left earth bed; a whole open plate-and-frame filter press stands on the raised right bed, with its collector and pulled plate left unchanged. One connected scene-only support floor forms a low front apron, two intermediate broad treads and three risers up to the press bed. The height-separated equipment arrangement and front stepped approach differ from the older flat grizzly screen with hopper wagon on a rail siding. All original meshes, directed triangles, normals, internal transforms and full material dictionaries remain unchanged at unit scale under translation only. No individual plate, roller or frame is extracted or counted again. One scene, zero new independent models, two whole instances. The two machines are not mechanically or hydraulically connected and no actual mining process is represented. Static art only: no material or liquid, filtering, crushing, transfer, work sequence, maintenance access, human clearance, navigation, structural load, slope or stair compliance, installation or safety claim.
